title: EFC-VAL-2026-006: Interim Audit Corrigendum to VAL-005 Stub-to-Real Data Transition, VariantH Genuine
description: Interim corrigendum auditing VAL-005 after upgrading three inputs from stub to DOI-traced observational data and patching five identified biases in the inference daemon. Re-runs show the earlier DESI DR1 non-MCMC Δχ² signal dissolves under DESI DR2 + real fσ8, and the EFC VariantH entropy-gradient growth model yields a genuine null under a symmetric prior and patched pipeline. The paper records Tier-1 fixes, institutes a reproducibility audit protocol, and flags an unresolved growth PPC anomaly (G2), concluding the EFC mechanism is currently underdetermined by the present expansion+growth probe stack.

hill_function_variantH.description: Hill-function form used in VariantH to modulate contribution (suppression weight) via the scale parameter \beta_0.

sbar0_symmetric_prior.description: Patched symmetric prior on the EFC coupling amplitude in VariantH, replacing the one-sided prior that biased results toward a null.

mu_clamp_relaxed.description: Relaxed lower bound on the VariantH growth-source clamp to permit physical suppression solutions (previously 0.5 \le \mu).

key_results.main_finding: Under real (DOI-traced) data and patched priors/pipeline, the DESI DR1 non-MCMC signal vanishes and VariantH delivers a genuine null with ΔAIC ≈ +3.9 favoring ΛCDM on parsimony, leaving EFC underdetermined by current probes.
datasets_used: DESI DR2 BAO (13 points, full covariance)
Pantheon binned SN Ia (Scolnic et al. 2018; full covariance)

sealed_predictions.statement: Growth-sector sealed predictions (fσ8/BAO) from VAL-005 are flagged as conditional on retired stub/DR1 inputs and require re-testing under DESI DR2 + real fσ8 with full covariance.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Re-run of the sealed growth predictions under DESI DR2 BAO + updated fσ8 compilation with full covariance; disagreement beyond calibrated null floors (G3/G4) falsifies the prior sealed set.

sealed_predictions.statement: Non-growth sealed predictions in GRAV/SPARC/Bullet sectors remain unaffected by this corrigendum.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Sector-specific tests (e.g., SPARC rotation curves, Bullet Cluster lensing mass–gravity inferences) as originally specified in their sealed derivation chains.

kill_criteria: KC1: After resolving the G2 (PPC growth) issue with GREEN audit gates, VariantH yields ΔAIC ≥ +10 in favor of ΛCDM across the expansion+growth probe stack with posterior_robustness and null_test wired; treat VariantH (current parameterization) as falsified for cosmologically relevant impact.

KC2: Under the symmetric prior S̄0 ~ U(-0.5, 0.5) and relaxed μ-clamp [0.3, 10], the posterior constrains |S̄0| to a neighborhood of zero that implies growth suppression indistinguishable from ΛCDM within measurement errors for 0 < z < 1 (95% credible), with GREEN robustness gates; declare VariantH ineffective and kill this mechanism variant.

KC3: The pathologically high growth PPC p-value (≈0.99) persists across independent seeds, subsets, and covariance audits (GREEN), indicating systematic model–data misfit rather than tooling error; reject VariantH for the growth sector.

KC4: Re-issued growth-sector sealed predictions fail against DESI DR2 BAO/RSD and the DOI-traced fσ8 compilation at ≥3σ with G3/G4 gates GREEN; classify the corresponding EFC growth mechanism as falsified.

related_packages.role: Base paper corrected by this interim audit corrigendum
